subject: Factor score regression for small samples

messages.author: a397060b4cabd6b8
messages.subject: Factor score regression for small samples
parts:
Hi all,

In the Before Times, I expected to get 300 responses to my survey and planned to do SEM. I had to stop collecting at 50, however, due to difficulties in recruitment.

I was wondering if anyone here has used lavaan and the methods described in this paper to conduct factor score regression with small samples. They provided their r code (attached).
https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2018.01699/full

I'm an r-user, not an r-programmer, so this wall of code feels a little ambitious for me.

I know that lavaan is working on a fsr/sam feature, but it's not ready, right?

Cheers,
Brit

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Factor score regression for small samples
parts:
On 6/30/20 12:14 AM, Brit wrote:
> I know that lavaan is working on a fsr/sam feature, but it's not ready,
> right?

It is not 'ready' for prime time, but it is available. The 'classic'
version is lavaan:::fsr(), the 'new' version is lavaan:::sam().

In principle, all you need to do is replace sem() by lavaan:::sam(), and
it should work automatically. If not, let me know (and provide a
reproducible example).

Yves.

messages.author: a397060b4cabd6b8
messages.subject: Re: Factor score regression for small samples
parts:
Yves,

Thank you! lavaan:::sam is working for my data (and performing as expected). I was just not sure if it was 'ready' in the sense that I could trust the SEs. Thank you for all of the work you put into this amazing package, by the way.

Brit
